tools.name: emailoctopus_list_lists
tools.description: List all lists in the account. Returns {data:[...],paging:{...}} — each list's id, name, contact counts by status, and created_at. Paginate with `limit` (max 100) and `starting_after` (cursor from the previous page). EmailOctopus: GET /lists.

tools.name: emailoctopus_get_list
tools.description: Get a single list by its id. Returns the list's full state — name, contact counts by status, and created_at. EmailOctopus: GET /lists/{list_id}.

tools.name: emailoctopus_list_contacts
tools.description: List the contacts in a list. Returns {data:[...],paging:{...}} — each contact's id, email_address, fields, tags, status, and created_at. Paginate with `limit` (max 100) and `starting_after`. EmailOctopus: GET /lists/{list_id}/contacts.

tools.name: emailoctopus_get_contact
tools.description: Get a single contact in a list. Returns email_address, fields, tags, status, and created_at. `contact_id` is the MD5 hash of the lowercased email address, or the `id` returned by emailoctopus_list_contacts. EmailOctopus: GET /lists/{list_id}/contacts/{contact_id}.

tools.name: emailoctopus_list_campaigns
tools.description: List all campaigns in the account. Returns {data:[...],paging:{...}} — each campaign's id, name, status, subject, and created_at. Paginate with `limit` (max 100) and `starting_after`. EmailOctopus: GET /campaigns.

tools.name: emailoctopus_get_campaign
tools.description: Get a single campaign by its id. Returns the campaign's full state — name, status, subject, from, content, and created_at. EmailOctopus: GET /campaigns/{campaign_id}.

tools.name: emailoctopus_get_campaign_report
tools.description: Get a campaign's aggregate performance report — sent, opened, clicked, bounced, unsubscribed, complained, and related counts. EmailOctopus: GET /campaigns/{campaign_id}/reports/summary.

tools.name: emailoctopus_get_campaign_links_report
tools.description: Get a campaign's per-link click report — for each link in the campaign, the URL and its click counts. EmailOctopus: GET /campaigns/{campaign_id}/reports/links.

tools.name: emailoctopus_create_list
tools.description: CREATES a new list — this MODIFIES live data. Provide a `name`. EmailOctopus: POST /lists. Returns the created list.

tools.name: emailoctopus_update_list
tools.description: UPDATES an existing list by id — this MODIFIES live data. Sets the list's `name`. EmailOctopus: PUT /lists/{list_id}. Returns the updated list.

tools.name: emailoctopus_create_contact
tools.description: CREATES a new contact in a list — this MODIFIES live data (adds a subscriber). `email_address` is required; optionally set `fields` (keyed by field tag), `tags`, and `status`. EmailOctopus: POST /lists/{list_id}/contacts. Returns the created contact.

tools.name: emailoctopus_update_contact
tools.description: UPDATES an existing contact in a list — this MODIFIES live data. Send only the fields you want to change (email_address, fields, tags, status). `contact_id` is the MD5 hash of the lowercased email address, or the id from list_contacts. EmailOctopus: PUT /lists/{list_id}/contacts/{contact_id}. Return

tools.name: emailoctopus_delete_contact
tools.description: PERMANENTLY REMOVES a contact from a list — this MODIFIES live data and cannot be undone. `contact_id` is the MD5 hash of the lowercased email address, or the id from list_contacts. EmailOctopus: DELETE /lists/{list_id}/contacts/{contact_id}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: emailoctopus_get_contact, emailoctopus_get_campaign_links_report, emailoctopus_create_list, emailoctopus_create_contact, emailoctopus_update_contact, emailoctopus_delete_contact · Private data: emailoctopus_list_lists, emailoctopus_get_list, emailoctopus_list_contacts, emailoctopus_get_contact, emailoctopus_create_contact, emailoctopus_update_contact, emailoctopus_delete_contact · Public sink: emailoctopus_get_contact, emailoctopus_create_list, emailoctopus_create_contact, emailoctopus_update_contact, emailoctopus_delete_contact · Destructive: emailoctopus_delete_contact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: emailoctopus_get_contact, emailoctopus_get_campaign_links_report, emailoctopus_create_list, emailoctopus_create_contact, emailoctopus_update_contact, emailoctopus_delete_contact · Private data: emailoctopus_list_lists, emailoctopus_get_list, emailoctopus_list_contacts, emailoctopus_get_contact, emailoctopus_create_contact, emailoctopus_update_contact, emailoctopus_delete_contact · Public sink: emailoctopus_get_contact, emailoctopus_create_list, emailoctopus_create_contact, emailoctopus_update_contact, emailoctopus_delete_contact · Destructive: emailoctopus_delete_contact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
